# brand.yml

Centralize brand guidelines in a single ‘brand.yml’ file, enabling
consistent theming across Quarto, Shiny, R applications, reports, and
presentations with minimal configuration.

## Installation

Install the latest release of brand.yml from CRAN with:

``` r

install.packages("brand.yml")
```

You can install the development version of brand.yml from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("posit-dev/brand-yml/pkg-r")
```

Alternatively, you can install from
[posit-dev.r-universe.dev](https://posit-dev.r-universe.dev/) with:

``` r

install.packages(
  'brand.yml',
  repos = c('https://posit-dev.r-universe.dev', 'https://cloud.r-project.org')
)
```

## Example

Use
[`read_brand_yml()`](https://posit-dev.github.io/brand-yml/pkg/r/dev/reference/read_brand_yml.md)
to read in a brand.yml file into a validated and consistent R list. You
can provide a path to a local file, or
[`read_brand_yml()`](https://posit-dev.github.io/brand-yml/pkg/r/dev/reference/read_brand_yml.md)
will look for a `_brand.yml` file in your project.

``` r

library(brand.yml)

brand <- read_brand_yml(
  system.file("examples", "brand-posit.yml", package = "brand.yml")
)

brand$color |> str()
#> List of 12
#>  $ palette   :List of 7
#>   ..$ blue    : chr "#447099"
#>   ..$ orange  : chr "#EE6331"
#>   ..$ gray    : chr "#404041"
#>   ..$ white   : chr "#FFFFFF"
#>   ..$ teal    : chr "#419599"
#>   ..$ green   : chr "#72994E"
#>   ..$ burgundy: chr "#9A4665"
#>  $ foreground: chr "#151515"
#>  $ background: chr "#FFFFFF"
#>  $ primary   : chr "#447099"
#>  $ secondary : chr "#707073"
#>  $ tertiary  : chr "#C2C2C4"
#>  $ success   : chr "#72994E"
#>  $ info      : chr "#419599"
#>  $ warning   : chr "#EE6331"
#>  $ danger    : chr "#9A4665"
#>  $ light     : chr "#FFFFFF"
#>  $ dark      : chr "#404041"
```

# Package index

## Read and normalize a brand.yml file

- [`read_brand_yml()`](https://posit-dev.github.io/brand-yml/pkg/r/dev/reference/read_brand_yml.md)
  : Create a Brand instance from a Brand YAML file.
- [`as_brand_yml()`](https://posit-dev.github.io/brand-yml/pkg/r/dev/reference/as_brand_yml.md)
  : Create a Brand instance from a list or character vector.

## branded Theming functions

Apply brand.yml themes to plots and tables from popular packages.

- [`theme_brand_flextable()`](https://posit-dev.github.io/brand-yml/pkg/r/dev/reference/theme_brand_flextable.md)
  : Create a flextable theme using brand colors
- [`theme_brand_ggplot2()`](https://posit-dev.github.io/brand-yml/pkg/r/dev/reference/theme_brand_ggplot2.md)
  : Create a ggplot2 theme using brand colors
- [`theme_brand_gt()`](https://posit-dev.github.io/brand-yml/pkg/r/dev/reference/theme_brand_gt.md)
  : Create a gt table theme using brand colors
- [`theme_brand_plotly()`](https://posit-dev.github.io/brand-yml/pkg/r/dev/reference/theme_brand_plotly.md)
  : Create a plotly theme using brand colors
- [`theme_brand_thematic()`](https://posit-dev.github.io/brand-yml/pkg/r/dev/reference/theme_brand_thematic.md)
  [`theme_brand_thematic_on()`](https://posit-dev.github.io/brand-yml/pkg/r/dev/reference/theme_brand_thematic.md)
  : Create a thematic theme using brand colors

## brand.yml helpers

- [`brand_use_logo()`](https://posit-dev.github.io/brand-yml/pkg/r/dev/reference/brand_use_logo.md)
  : Extract a logo resource from a brand

- [`brand_color_pluck()`](https://posit-dev.github.io/brand-yml/pkg/r/dev/reference/brand_color_pluck.md)
  : Extract a color value from a brand object

- [`brand_has()`](https://posit-dev.github.io/brand-yml/pkg/r/dev/reference/brand_has.md)
  : Check if a brand has a specific nested element

- [`brand_pluck()`](https://posit-dev.github.io/brand-yml/pkg/r/dev/reference/brand_pluck.md)
  : Extract a nested element from a brand object

- [`with_brand_yml_path()`](https://posit-dev.github.io/brand-yml/pkg/r/dev/reference/with_brand_yml_path.md)
  [`local_brand_yml_path()`](https://posit-dev.github.io/brand-yml/pkg/r/dev/reference/with_brand_yml_path.md)
  :

  Temporarily set the `BRAND_YML_PATH` environment variable

## brand.yml Sass utilities

- [`brand_sass_color()`](https://posit-dev.github.io/brand-yml/pkg/r/dev/reference/brand_sass_color.md)
  : Generate Sass variables for brand colors
- [`brand_sass_color_palette()`](https://posit-dev.github.io/brand-yml/pkg/r/dev/reference/brand_sass_color_palette.md)
  : Generate Sass variables and CSS custom properties for brand color
  palette
- [`brand_sass_defaults_bootstrap()`](https://posit-dev.github.io/brand-yml/pkg/r/dev/reference/brand_sass_defaults_bootstrap.md)
  : Generate Sass variables and layer for Bootstrap defaults
- [`brand_sass_fonts()`](https://posit-dev.github.io/brand-yml/pkg/r/dev/reference/brand_sass_fonts.md)
  : Generate Sass variables and CSS rules for brand fonts
- [`brand_sass_typography()`](https://posit-dev.github.io/brand-yml/pkg/r/dev/reference/brand_sass_typography.md)
  : Generate Sass variables for brand typography
